name: Low Calorie Pandan Ice Cream
desc: A low calorie version of pandan ice cream with no compromise on flavor and texture.
note: 147 calories per 1/2 cup serving (or 587 calories for one pint)!
steps: Whisk together the cornstarch with 2 tbsp of the whole milk until smooth. Set aside.
Simmer the whole milk, heavy cream, and dry milk powder in a saucepan until the mixture is hot (but not boiling). I aim for around 150°F.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolks with the sugar, allulose, and salt. Slowly pour some of the hot cream mixture into the yolks while whisking to temper them.
Pour the tempered yolks back into the saucepan and add the cornstarch slurry. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the custard thickens (about 170°F).
Stir in the vanilla extract and pandan extract.
Remove from heat and strain through a fine-mesh sieve.
Add the reduced-fat cream cheese to the custard and blend until smooth.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours.
Churn in an ice cream maker until it reaches soft-serve consistency.
Transfer to containers and freeze overnight.
